target_customer: Independent full service restaurants and bars
problem: A POS only knows what staff type in, so seating, wait quotes and staffing are guesswork. Restaurants lose table turns when guests wait to order or pay.
business_model: Restaurant software and POS suite, pricing not public
product_category: Restaurant operations, computer vision and POS

competitors.what: Turns security cameras into restaurant operations tools

competitors.name: DifiNative TableWatch
competitors.what: Vision AI for table visibility and guest flow

technical_complexity.rationale: Running vision models on existing CCTV to infer table states is solvable with current models, though accuracy across varied cameras and a bundled POS adds work for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: A POS plus camera bundle creates switching costs, but several vendors sell similar camera analytics and POS vendors can add the feature.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Camera analytics vendors were already active in 2025. No incumbent action against Shire is public.

market_need_then: Restaurants run on thin margins and table turn time directly drives revenue, and AI camera tools were being marketed to restaurants through 2025.

branding.domain_note: Uses shireintelligence.com with an Intelligence suffix

identity.visual_style: Product suite pages branded Shire POS, Shire Agent and Shire Enterprise

brand_strength.rationale: Shire is a common word and brand name in other industries, and no press about this brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Shire joined YC in Fall 2026 with restaurant experienced founders, and has no exit or failure yet. The site names a few small restaurants and claims a 12 percent reduction in table turn time, which is self reported. It sells a full POS bundle in a crowded restaurant tech market, so the open question is whether camera intelligence can pull restaurants off incumbent POS systems.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom shows a $125k seed with hidden investors, single aggregator, so no round recorded. The site claims Premier startup accelerator logos but names no investor. A search could not independently confirm the YC batch beyond the YC page. Prior employers for CEO and CFO were not listed.
